items.name: Claude connector
items.description: Add the Citehound MCP server to Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code. Free and read-only, no account.

items.name: MCP Registry listing
items.description: The Citehound MCP server is published in the MCP Registry, with its 13 read-only tools described on the MCP page.

items.name: GitHub Action
items.description: The official Citehound GitHub Action scans a domain from a workflow and can fail a build when the score is below a number you set.

items.name: Public API
items.description: A JSON API with an OpenAPI description: scan, compare, crawler access and generated files with a free key, and monitoring, the fix list and exports on Pro, Fix and Beyond.

items.name: Command-line tool
items.description: Scan a domain, compare two sites and generate llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD from a terminal or a build. No account and no dependencies; an API key is optional.

items.name: n8n node
items.description: Nodes for n8n to scan, compare, generate files and read monitoring events, with a polling trigger. It is a community node: it has not been through n8n's own review. An API key is needed; a free one is sent by email.

items.name: Claude plugin
items.description: Adds the Citehound MCP server and three guided skills (scan a site, fix AI crawler access, compare with a competitor) to Claude. It installs from our own GitHub marketplace, andacuzel/cited-geo-guide, not from Anthropic's plugin directory.
install: Claude desktop app: Plugins → Add → marketplace "andacuzel/cited-geo-guide" → install "citehound"
Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add andacuzel/cited-geo-guide, then /plugin install citehound@citehound
